desc: A chair or table blockout. Legs and slats are the weak point - narrow gaps web over into solid panels.
source_prompt: a single wooden armchair, four straight legs, padded seat cushion, high back with vertical slats, two flat armrests, the whole chair inside the frame with margin on all sides, three-quarter view, flat mid-grey seamless background, even frontal light, no cast shadow, no room, no rug, no other furniture
output: untextured GLB mesh, POSITION attribute only, ~525k tris, ~8.5 MB, 19.5 s
usable_for: blockout, proportion and scale check, silhouette reference
not_usable_for: direct game import - needs retopology, UV unwrap and texture bake. Not usable where the gaps between slats or legs must be real holes.
note: Expect the negative space to fail before the positive space does: at octree 256 the gaps between slats and between legs frequently web over into a solid panel, because the voxel grid cannot resolve a gap thinner than one cell. Raising octree_resolution to 384 is the documented fix and costs a lot of memory; neither value has been rendered per-preset on this box. threshold 0.5 is a compromise for the thin legs.
